summary: Refactored workspace inspector to drop WorkspaceView/WorkspacePanel and the legacy createView contract, making the app render all static and runtime inspector tabs as peers with a default-first selection and app-owned empty state. Migrated Unity to contribute its own Unity inspector tab alongside Console/Subagents/Workflows, removed Unity-specific editor context menu items and nested navigation, and rebuilt the registry bundles. Renamed showUnityInspector to showInspector with migration, and tightened CSS tokens (border-radius, font-size) flagged by the design-system detector.
decisions: Removed WorkspaceView, WorkspacePanel, and createView() in favor of peer inspector tabs contributed by each extension, with default selection being the first available extension tab.
Added an app-owned empty state for when no inspector UI is enabled.
Unity now contributes a normal 'Unity' inspector tab; Console, Subagents, and Workflows are sibling tabs; Unity's nested Status/Console navigation was removed.
Removed Unity-specific editor actions from the global context menu; they remain available via Unity's panel and command contributions.
Renamed showUnityInspector to showInspector with a migration for existing settings.
Titlebar identity is now app-owned and shows project + enabled extension count.

Replaced literal CSS values flagged by the design-system detector with documented tokens: border-radius calc(...-3px) -> var(--radius-sm), border-radius 2px -> var(--radius-xs), font-size 9px -> var(--text-2xs).
errors: CSS edit failed because font-size: 9px had two occurrences; retried with surrounding context to make each match unique, then succeeded.
pnpm check failed due to three pre-existing files exceeding the 300-line limit (skills-library.css 334, resource-catalog.ts 333, settings-parts/layout.css 312); flagged as unrelated to this refactor.

design-system antipattern detector flagged literal border-radius values (calc(...-3px), 2px) and font-size 9px in inspector-parts/layout.css as outside DESIGN.md tokens; resolved by switching to --radius-sm, --radius-xs, and --text-2xs.
